title: Does not have corner ties
text: Does not have corner ties. Another fail for the makers of this duvet cover! It does not have the ties on the inside corners so you can hold your duvet in place. Needless to say, your duvet moves around inside the cover and it is a constant battle to fix it throughout the night. It's not quality softness, it's more like a scratchy soft. But the design and the print is gorgeous! I only wish the texture of the material was nicer against my skin and that it had corner ties.
